answer: An identity's weight is paid by strangers. Over twelve epochs it counts counterparties that settled invoices, each backing at most three identities and six epochs deep in payments to providers outside the applicant's cluster, layers like shale bedding. Weight is that count over three, capped at one. A thousand clones need three thousand buyers at $12 to $35. One buyer covers three clones, so the set is rebuilt every four epochs: $36,000 to $105,000 up front, $9,000 an epoch. Payment from a stranger is a thread you cannot spin alone; a fire fed on its own embers warms nobody outside it.
